evidence_links_subject_matches_type_chec.name: evidence_links_subject_matches_type_check
evidence_links_subject_matches_type_chec.value:
(subject_type = 'assessment_response' AND assessment_response_id IS NOT NULL AND control_test_id IS NULL AND remediation_action_id IS NULL AND validation_record_id IS NULL)
          OR (subject_type = 'control_test' AND control_test_id IS NOT NULL AND assessment_response_id IS NULL AND remediation_action_id IS NULL AND validation_record_id IS NULL)
          OR (subject_type = 'remediation_action' AND remediation_action_id IS NOT NULL AND assessment_response_id IS NULL AND control_test_id IS NULL AND validation_record_id IS NULL)
          OR (subject_type = 'validation_record' AND validation_record_id IS NOT NULL AND assessment_response_id IS NULL AND control_test_id IS NULL AND remediation_action_id IS NULL)

evidence_links_requires_engagement_check.name: evidence_links_requires_engagement_check
evidence_links_requires_engagement_check.value: subject_type = 'control_test' OR engagement_id IS NOT NULL

risks_residual_likelihood_range_check.name: risks_residual_likelihood_range_check
risks_residual_likelihood_range_check.value: residual_likelihood IS NULL OR residual_likelihood BETWEEN 1 AND 5

risks_residual_impact_range_check.name: risks_residual_impact_range_check
risks_residual_impact_range_check.value: residual_impact IS NULL OR residual_impact BETWEEN 1 AND 5

validation_records_only_accepted_trigger.name: validation_records_only_accepted_triggers_reassessment_check
validation_records_only_accepted_trigger.value: outcome = 'accepted' OR (triggers_control_test_id IS NULL AND triggers_assessment_response_id IS NULL)

validation_records_at_most_one_reassessm.name: validation_records_at_most_one_reassessment_target_check
validation_records_at_most_one_reassessm.value: triggers_control_test_id IS NULL OR triggers_assessment_response_id IS NULL

maturity_scores_weight_requires_domain_c.name: maturity_scores_weight_requires_domain_check
maturity_scores_weight_requires_domain_c.value: maturity_domain_weight_id IS NULL OR maturity_domain_id IS NOT NULL
